{{Top}}
[[File:Acklay-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|Acklays had a combination of crustacean and reptile traits.]]
A '''crustacean''' was a class of animal life. The [[Sauvax]] were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] crustaceans,<ref>{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}; ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> as were the [[Tarc]].<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> The [[Worrite]]s had both crustacean and [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] features.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The non-sentient [[ibliton]] was a [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]]-crustacean [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]].<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> The [[suuri]] of [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] were crustaceans.<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]] was a crustacean/[[Fish/Legends|fish]] hybrid.<ref name="wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
